models.model: EB 35% adjusted Potential + 5% adjusted actual PPG + 50% Starter + 10% Roster / NIG
models.selection: Original weekly-point prediction objective: minimum inner season CV RMSE across every remaining weekly score; outer test season absent from every upstream fit

potential_pairs.method: Same conditional empirical normalized PF/Potential gap and bye features; neighbor count retuned inside outer training data; no added bias correction

models.availability_model: Status-aware horizon/duration logistic; 2022-2025 MFL histories; known upcoming absence hard gate
models.player_uncertainty_model: Smooth mean-preserving Johnson SU, continuous strength/position scale; fitted roster variance response; NIG team shape retained

league_environment.scope: one factor per simulation/week shared by all 32 teams

models.potential_input: 40% adjusted Potential / 0% adjusted actual PPG / 55% Starter Strength / 5% Roster Strength
models.player_ability_update: fully refitted injury-aware weekly Sharks with shared position bias

potential_points.validation: Full 2026 retraining; neighbor count selected by held-out-season conditional-gap error

models.description: All ADL forecasts use one Empirical-Bayes scoring model. Team strength combines 35% availability-adjusted Potential, 5% adjusted actual PPG, 50% projected Starter Strength and 10% projected Roster Strength, with reliability and uncertainty learned together. Player forecasts use public Fantasy Sharks Week 1 priors updated by actual performances, calibrated weekly Fantasy Sharks projections, opponent strength and availability. Weekly uncertainty reflects smooth asymmetric player scoring curves and availability risk in the expected legal lineup. Weekly scoring variation uses a Normal-inverse-Gaussian distribution learned from normalized scoring history beginning in 2018. Bonus Games, H2H, All-Play and playoff odds use the same simulated scores.
